identity.mission: Create a police accountability platform that feels like a 'Civil Rights Command Center'. It must balance the gravity of legal defense with the urgency of emergency response. No generic SaaS templates. Fusion of 'Swiss Legal Brutalism' and 'Cyber-Security Dashboard'.
principles: Fusion: Legal Authority (Serif) + Emergency Tech (Neon/Dark Mode)
Content: Every pixel serves the citizen's right to justice
Contrast: High contrast for readability in stressful situations

typography.instructions: Use 'Libre Baskerville' for all H1-H3 headings to evoke constitutional authority. Use 'Public Sans' for UI, forms, and body text for government-grade clarity. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for evidence timestamps and case IDs.

spacing.rule: Use generous spacing. Minimum p-6 for cards. p-24 for section gaps.

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use for 'Know Your Rights' cards. A subtle glowing border that traces the card on hover.
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Add a subtle noise texture to the dark mode background to prevent banding and add 'film' quality.

hero_background.usage: Landing page hero background with heavy overlay

evidence_abstract.usage: Background for Evidence Library or AI Attorney section

icons.instructions: Use Lucide icons for all UI elements. Use 'Shield', 'Scale', 'Siren', 'FileText', 'MapPin' heavily.

structure: Hero: Full width, centered typography, 'Get Protection' CTA.
Features: Bento Grid (3x4). Mix of large feature cards and small stat blocks.
Testimonials: Horizontal scroll with 'Legal Paper' texture.
CTA: High contrast 'Emergency Red' section for SOS app download.
Main Content: Dense grid. 'Live Map' takes 2x2 span. 'Recent Alerts' takes 1x2 span.
Center: Massive pulsing SOS button (50vw max width).
Bottom: 'Slide to Cancel' or 'I am Safe' secondary actions.

custom_components.name: IncidentCard
custom_components.description: Card displaying police encounter details. Must include map snippet, timestamp (mono font), and severity badge.

custom_components.name: RightsWizard
custom_components.description: Step-by-step interactive guide for police encounters. Large typography, simple 'Yes/No' choices.

custom_components.name: EvidenceUploader
custom_components.description: Drag and drop zone with 'Blockchain Verification' badge animation on success.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Update index.css with the provided HSL variables immediately.
2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts link to public/index.html.
3. LANDING: Build the Landing Page first using the 'Tetris Grid' layout. Use the 'Courthouse' image as a subtle background.
4. DASHBOARD: Create the Dashboard shell with Sidebar and Header. Use 'Control Room' density.
5. SOS: Implement the SOS page with extreme contrast (Red/Black).
6. AI ATTORNEY: Use the 'Chat' interface from Shadcn but style it like a secure messaging app (Signal/Telegram style).
7. CRITICAL: Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Ensure mobile responsiveness is tested (max-h-80vh for images).
